name: bhabhi-thulla
description: A production-ready multiplayer Bhabhi Thulla card game with React, Socket.IO, bots, and SQLite.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @getaway-cards/shared build && pnpm --filter @getaway-cards/server build && pnpm --filter @getaway-cards/client build
scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @getaway-cards/shared build && concurrently -n server,client -c cyan,magenta "pnpm --filter @getaway-cards/server dev" "pnpm --filter @getaway-cards/client dev"
